description: This bar chart illustrates the popularity scores for different language models across several knowledge domains. The horizontal axis represents the knowledge domain categories—Songs, Basketball—with labels presented in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 240, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Four distinct bar groupings are presented for each knowledge domain, representing the language models Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), ChatGPT (orange), and Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=1 & GT Ans (hatched bars). Within each grouping, bars represent the popularity score for each model; for example, in the “Songs” category, Llama3 has a popularity score of approximately 190, Qwen2 is around 140, ChatGPT is approximately 110, and Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=1 & GT Ans is around 70. In the “Basketball” category, Llama3 has a popularity score of approximately 220, Qwen2 is around 180, ChatGPT is approximately 150, and Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=1 & GT Ans is around 100. The bars are arranged in groupings corresponding to the knowledge domain, and a single bar within the “Basketball” grouping for Llama3 is visually emphasized with a circular marker.
